name: break-ui
description: Stress-test a piece of UI with realistic worst-case data, report what breaks, and give the fix for each.

interface.longDescription: Feed a component or screen realistic worst-case data, render it behind a Demo data / Worst case toggle, and report every break with its fix.
defaultPrompt: Break this UI with worst-case data.
Stress-test this component and tell me what snaps.
